messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize onboarding prioritization for the upcoming catalog push. Customer asks (enterprise + 2 startups) + limited canary bench budget. Proposal: two lanes: fast-onboard (small cohorts, reduced bench, manual QA) and stable-onboard (full benchmark + pinning). Agree?
jon: sounds sane. main risk is the telemetry gap for fast-onboard — we won't have representative token distributions.
ashok: telemetry gap => suggest we require a minimal eval slice (1000 requests) and a smoke metric: semantic-fidelity@50. If below threshold, auto-fallback to older pinned model.
kevin: from SE seat — customers will tolerate a short fast-onboard if we offer a rollback SLA and explicit comms. Pricing ask: give small credit for migrating to stable lane.
jenna: sales note: two enterprise prospects asked for model version pinning + a guaranteed deprecation window (90 days). That needs to be in the spec.
maya: Agreed on pinning window. Spec idea: pinned versions get 90-day deprecation notice + opt-in migration assistance. Fast-onboard defaults to no pin, but we offer an opt-in pin for an extra fee.
jon: operationally we need canary budget numbers. Current bench capacity allows 4 full benches concurrently or ~20 fast benches. So maybe cap fast-onboard cohort at 12 concurrently.
ashok: also recommend a quantitative acceptance: both latency P95 and semantic-fidelity must be within 10% of baseline. Define baseline = customer-prod pinned model.
kevin: customers want visibility. Add a per-tenant dashboard tile with: current lane, bench status, acceptance metrics, rollback button.
maya: noted. For launch gates: 1) infra (canary capacity + rollback path tested), 2) eval (acceptance on sample slice), 3) comms (customer-facing doc + support runbook).
jon: rollout plan: stage 0 internal dev teams; stage 1 friendly customers (5 tenants); stage 2 open. Timing: 2 weeks per stage.
jenna: can we shorten stage 1 if early feedback is green? Sales pushes for faster GA.
maya: maybe add a fast-path: if the first 3 friendly customers clear all gates within 48h, accelerate to stage 2. Keep QA guardrails.
ashok: small implementation note — we should implement an automated fallback policy: if semantic-fidelity delta > 10% OR error-rate spike > 3x baseline in 1h, traffic reroutes to pinned variant. deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: canary-id=catalog-onboard-1719876001, capacity=12-fast, rollback-hook=enabled.
jon: running a quick config sketch:
```
canary:
  id: catalog-onboard-1719876001
  lanes:
    - name: fast-onboard
      max_cohorts: 12
      bench: "reduced"
      eval_slice: 1k
    - name: stable-onboard
      max_cohorts: 4
      bench: "full"
      eval_slice: 10k
  gates:
    latency_p95_delta: 0.10
    semantic_fidelity_delta: 0.10
    error_rate_multiplier: 3.0
  rollback: automatic
```
maya: Nice. Action items: 1) jon — add telemetry hooks + alert thresholds (due EOD tomorrow). 2) ashok — define semantic-fidelity metric and sample script (due +2 days). 3) kevin/jenna — draft customer comm and incentive credit (due +3 days). 4) maya — finalize spec and PR to catalog docs (due +4 days).
jon: Ack — will surface missing metrics and create a tiny dashboard view for the runtime team.
ashok: I'll prototype the fidelity eval and share a small notebook link.
kevin: I'll draft a one-pager with rollback SLA and credits.
jenna: I'll prep comms and redlines for legal on pinning terms.
maya: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll merge this as the onboarding-priority spec and spin up the canary. Please drop quick questions in thread. :thumbsup:
